# Legal Risk and Regulatory Monitoring for Strategy 2026

This document outlines critical areas requiring immediate attention for risk management and compliance within the bank.

*   We need to monitor the legal risks urgently.
*   We need to monitor the internal control for strategy 2026.
*   We need to update the regulatory changes based on audit.
*   We need to review the regulatory changes for strategy 2026.
*   We need to investigate the internal control standard update.
